prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Interactive Tutorial: Adds a new interactive tutorial screen after home_intro demonstrating how to drag, hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support emails highlight user confusion around controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, leading to drop-off at the final step.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story & Path Stage Carousel Redesign: Redesigns choose_path screen with a spotlight layout featuring path choice cards highlighting quick pick versus custom pet creation. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating indecision on path selection.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Preparation Guide Screen: Adds a new photo preparation guidance screen before photo upload explaining clear photo requirements to avoid AI rendering errors. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding failed or distorted custom pet generation during photo upload.)
3: [finish, hint] Quick Desktop Control Hints on Home Intro: Adds mouse control tip cards and keyboard shortcut hints directly to the home_intro welcome screen. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and users frequently contact support regarding post-onboarding pet control confusion.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Account Sign-In Cloud Backup Incentive Badge: Displays a prominent cloud backup badge and incentive offer explaining that signing in protects pets across devices. (why: Sign-in step converts at 77.0% and 8 support tickets were sent about missing/reset pets after re-authenticating.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pet Selection Screen Card Grid Layout: Updates the pick_friend screen layout to carousel with interactive pet sound preview buttons and rounded choice cards. (why: Adoption is the lowest converting step in the entire funnel at 60.9%.)
6: [choose_path, new_flow] Animated Story Prologue Screen Flow: Adds an animated story intro screen new_story_prologue at the start of onboarding to establish context before path selection. (why: The choose_path median time is 8s but mean time is 514s, indicating user confusion or hesitation at startup.)
